quality_rule: PASS only if: (a) zero verified errors (wrong known player, unknown named, mixed track, bench/non-player) among links the candidate adds or changes relative to v2; (b) synthetic-unknown false matches not higher than v2; (c) at least 5 added links verified correct. Any added verified error -> FAIL. Fewer than 5 verified added links, or more than half of added links unverifiable -> INCONCLUSIVE.
